identity.description: Convert all faces in a mesh to triangular faces

enum_items.name: Beauty
enum_items.description: Split the quads in nice triangles, slower method

enum_items.name: Fixed
enum_items.description: Split the quads on the first and third vertices

enum_items.name: Fixed Alternate
enum_items.description: Split the quads on the 2nd and 4th vertices

enum_items.name: Shortest Diagonal
enum_items.description: Split the quads along their shortest diagonal

enum_items.name: Longest Diagonal
enum_items.description: Split the quads along their longest diagonal

enum_items.name: Clip
enum_items.description: Split the polygons with an ear clipping algorithm
